english.title: Provisional licence holder fail surrender for change of name and address
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a provisional driving licence in which your

(A)_[name]_
(B)_[address]_
(C)_[name and address]_

as specified therein ceased to be correct, failed without reasonable excuse to surrender forthwith the

(D)_[licence]_
(E)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to the Secretary to State and provide him with particulars of the alterations failing to be made to the said

(F)_[name]_
(G)_[address]_
(H)_[name and address]_

and with a statement of your sex and date of birth
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(5) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The option 'licence and its counterpart' relates to licences which came into force on or after 1st June 1990 (1st January 1991 in the case of licences granted under the law of Northern Ireland). the "counterpart" details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) See also associated offence wording as follows: H57 for the related charge heading re full driving licence holders failing to notify change of name or address.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:

(D)_[licence]_
(E)_[licence and its counterpart]_

(F)_[his]_
(G)_[her]_

other.penalty:
